caption: Historical graph-score comparison: Native throughput loss for six selectors in fixed model/setup groups. Every column uses the same historical Native reference measurements within a row. Parentheses give candidate counts; column headers count exact/tie-aware winner agreements. The stored hardware-fit profile is the H10 profile on every setup. The historical reported YOLOv7 Native overlay and archived Generic records remain separate from current A4 deployments. No current quality filter is applied to this historical cohort.
